Gentle day a helpful note for anyone travelling with a pet
Please read this before you travel

Pet Travel Notice

Travelers need to bring the right papers and keep their animal ready for security checks and cabin acceptance.

The senior coordinator reviews each booking with the cabin team so the care plan fits the species, temperament, and comfort needs of the animal. For rabbit travel, <<FACT F082>> Keep your pet secure, calm, and under control at all points in the journey. If the carrier is damaged, too small, or poorly closed, service may be delayed until it meets our standards.

Aurelia Skyways expects travelers to arrive prepared, with clean carriers, clear labels, and any required health papers ready for review. The Companion Animal Travel Desk can check the booking notes and help with the usual steps before departure. If there is any concern about fit, behavior, or paperwork, bring it to us early so we can sort it out without delay.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you go.
